dlentry.dt: Expand abbreviation [Alt + Shift + E (Ctrl + Shift + E on macOS)]

dd.p: In Text mode, after entering an abbreviation, invoking this action will expand a valid abbreviation into a code snippet, depending on the document type.
In Author mode, invoking the action opens a dialog box where you can enter an abbreviation. After you click OK, a valid abbreviation is expanded into a code snippet, depending on the document type.
dd.note: For HTML, CSS, LESS, or XML-based document types, you can also use Ctrl + Space to expand Emmet abbreviations.

dlentry.dt: Wrap with abbreviation [Alt + Shift + W (Ctrl + Shift + W on macOS)]

dd.p: It opens a dialog box where you can enter an abbreviation and after clicking OK, the abbreviation is expanded with the selected content added in the last element of the generated snippet.
